request.text: Great job pressing the left key! Now, for your next challenge: press the right key. I believe in you. Take all the time you need.
request.reference_text: Hi there, Warden-slayer! I am so, so excited to help you today! Let's learn how to move. Isn't moving fun? I think moving is fun!

direction: Maximum cheer, as if this were the most important lesson ever taught; tiny forced giggle at the end.
